name: Necrotic Resurrection
notes: In game (hwp_pri_necrotic_resurrection, tested): aim at an intact body within 150; a channel under a raising buff that silences you (3 s, 5 s for an elite's body, 10 s for a boss's) then raises a copy of the enemy on your team with its own skills, at 50/60/70/85/100% of its health and damage, up to 2/2/3/3/4 risen (past the cap the oldest dies); a risen has at least 120 health (a 60-health wasp died to one brute in two seconds), and one that cannot move (the heavy ballista) loses its minimum range. Heresy +1 normal, +2 elite, +3 boss; refused at 5 Heresy. Mana 70 (spent on activation), cooldown 20 s. Risen health decays 1% every 3 s (9 s for a boss) and never heals; they teleport back to you like other summons when 350 away. Every one of the 141 raisable enemies and the 10 non-final bosses raised and checked by plan-forgemaster 20261022-102006 and plan-forgemaster-bosses 20261022-084131 (bosses at 3000-8000 health, their arena-only skills stripped). Assumed: the 150 raise range, the channel times, the decay rate, the boss health caps, the 120 health floor, the 60 s a body lasts. Cast on the body you aim at: takes 3 seconds to complete, 5 seconds for an elite, 10 for a boss. Heresy per raise: normal +1, elite +2, boss +3. At 5 or more Heresy raising is blocked; below that a raise may overshoot 5 (a boss at 4 Heresy makes 7). At max Divine Favor the skill turns into Sacrificial Penance (its own entry, shown in this card as the alternate form). Summons last until killed or decayed: they lose 1% health every 3 seconds, a boss every 9 seconds. Past the summon cap the oldest dies. Every summon, bosses included, follows you to new floors. Risen summons can't be healed: the Lantern's Holy Light and other ally heals skip them (vanilla PlayerHeal heals any actor on your team, so the build has to exclude them). Boss resurrection must be unlocked through Deeper Depravity. Not free any more: the spec's free level is Divine Favor's instead. Level numbers are a first pass.
summary: Reanimate an intact body left by Call of Heresy as a loyal summon that fights for you. Their health decays slowly over time. Each summon adds Heresy: 1 for a normal enemy, 2 for an elite, 3 for a boss; at 5 Heresy you can no longer raise the dead. At max Divine Favor the skill becomes Sacrificial Penance: channel for 3 seconds to sacrifice an intact body and remove Heresy.
